questions.original:
A client selects high risk tolerance in an app, but needs most of the invested money for a house
   purchase in one year. The robo-adviser recommends an equity-heavy portfolio based only on
   that answer.

   What should the adviser reconsider first?

    A) Whether a higher expected equity return is enough to offset the cash requirement.

    B) Whether a cheaper fund removes the need to assess the client’s time horizon.

    C) The short horizon and cash requirement limit the client’s capacity to bear losses,
       regardless of stated preference.

   D) Whether using an automated questionnaire makes the recommendation suitable by itself.

options.A: Whether a higher expected equity return is enough to offset the cash requirement.
options.B: Whether a cheaper fund removes the need to assess the client’s time horizon.
options.C: The short horizon and cash requirement limit the client’s capacity to bear losses, regardless of stated preference.
options.D: Whether using an automated questionnaire makes the recommendation suitable by itself.

answers.chinese: 选 C。即使愿意接受下跌
answers.english: C. The short horizon and cash requirement constrain

questions.original:
A payment firm keeps live records and backups under the same administrator account. An
   attacker takes over that account and encrypts both copies.

   Which change most directly improves the firm’s ability to recover?

    A) Maintain separately protected backups and test restoration regularly.

    B) Replicate records more often under the same administrator account.

    C) Encrypt the live database more strongly under the same access rules.

   D) Retain more login alerts without changing how backups are protected.

options.A: Maintain separately protected backups and test restoration regularly.
options.B: Replicate records more often under the same administrator account.
options.C: Encrypt the live database more strongly under the same access rules.
options.D: Retain more login alerts without changing how backups are protected.

questions.original:
A screening system flags a customer whose name matches a sanctions entry. The date of birth
   differs, and the record has no verified passport number.

   What is the best next step?

    A) Reject the customer automatically because the name matches exactly.

    B) Close the alert automatically because one field differs.

    C) Verify identity evidence, document the review, and escalate unresolved doubt.

   D) Raise the screening threshold for all customers to reduce similar alerts.

options.A: Reject the customer automatically because the name matches exactly.
options.B: Close the alert automatically because one field differs.
options.C: Verify identity evidence, document the review, and escalate unresolved doubt.
options.D: Raise the screening threshold for all customers to reduce similar alerts.
